memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder with allergic rhinitis and stage 1 hypertension.
She reports persistent worry, restlessness, mild dyspnea on exertion, nasal congestion and itchy eyes. BP 138/86, pulse 78, BMI 24. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L, FEV1/FVC 0.84; unchanged from baseline. ACT score 18 (not well controlled). Technique checked: correct (no inhaler prescribed).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Resting 12-lead ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, axis +30°, QRS duration 86 ms, QT 380 ms corrected 410 ms. No evidence of left ventricular hypertrophy or ischemia. Blood pressure during recording 138/86 mmHg.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy to penicillin: rash and pruritus within 30 minutes of oral amoxicillin course two years ago.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling on edge most days, worrying about work and health. My nose is constantly blocked and I sneeze in the mornings. I’m taking the medicines as prescribed but still feel tense.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up pulmonology appointment booked for 2025-07-15 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder partially controlled; allergic rhinitis symptomatic; hypertension stage 1.
She notes improved sleep but still daytime worry, nasal congestion worse on pollen days, occasional headaches. BP 132/84, pulse 76. Spirometry: FEV1 2.88 L (93% pred), FVC 3.42 L, FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 +0.03 L. ACT score 20 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct.

memories.text: Office spirometry performed: FEV1 2.88 L, FVC 3.42 L, FEV1/FVC ratio 0.84. No bronchodilator response (<12% change).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Psychiatry for optimisation of anxiety management; consider CBT and possible medication review. Include recent GAD-7 scores and current treatment.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Psychiatry review completed: Patient engaged in CBT, escitalopram increased to 15 mg OD effective 2025-12-02, buspirone continued. Advised to continue current allergy and hypertension meds. Follow‑up in 8 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder well controlled; allergic rhinitis mild; hypertension at target.
She reports minimal worry, good sleep, occasional nasal itch. BP 124/78, pulse 72. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% pred), FVC 3.44 L, FEV1/FVC 0.85; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L since last visit. ACT score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct.
